name: Maestro Disciple
body:
The power of music is a form of magic in itself. Descended from powerful bards or monsters that used music, song, or voice abilities as their weapons, maestro disciples distill their art into the purest form of entertainment and enchantment.

Requirements

To qualify to become a maestro disciple, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

Feats: Persuasive.
Skills: Perform 5 ranks.
Spellcasting: Ability to cast 1st-level spells. If the character has sorcerer or bloodrager levels, she must have the maestro bloodline. If the character gains levels of sorcerer or bloodrager after taking this class, she must take the maestro bloodline.
Special: Bardic performance, raging song, or an ability that functions as one of these (such as the fascinate ability of the sorcerer’s maestro bloodline or the battle song ability of the bloodrager’s maestro bloodline).
Class Skills

The maestro disciple’s class skills are Bluff (Cha), Diplomacy (Cha), Intimidate (Cha), Knowledge (arcana, local) (Int), Linguistics (Int), Perception (Wis), Perform (Cha), and Sense Motive (Wis)

Skill Ranks at Each Level: 2 + Int modifier.

Hit Die: d8.

Spells per Day

At the indicated levels, a maestro disciple gains new spells per day as if she had also gained a level in a spellcasting class she belonged to before adding the prestige class. She does not, however, gain other benefits a character of that class would have gained, except for additional spells per day, spells known (if she is a spontaneous spellcaster), and an increased effective level of spellcasting. If a character had more than one spellcasting class before becoming a maestro disciple, she must decide to which class she adds the new level for purposes of determining spells per day.

Blood of Music

A maestro disciple adds her level to her sorcerer or bloodrager levels when determining the powers gained from her bloodline. A character with levels in both bloodrager and sorcerer must choose which class stacks with her maestro disciple levels to determine her bloodline powers. If she does not have levels in sorcerer or bloodrager, she instead gains bloodline powers of the maestro sorcerer bloodline, using her maestro disciple level as her sorcerer level to determine the bonuses gained. This ability does not grant bonus spells to a sorcerer or bloodrager unless she possesses spell slots of an appropriate level. Such bonus spells are automatically granted if the sorcerer or bloodrager gains spell slots of the spell’s level.

Conductor

At 1st level, the maestro disciple adds her level in this prestige class to her level in a class that grants bardic performance, raging song, or a class ability that functions as either of these. If the maestro disciple only possesses such an ability through her bloodline, she instead gains bardic performance as a bard of her same level.

Table: Maestro Disciple
Level	Base Attack Bonus	Fort Save	Ref Save	Will Save	Special	Spells per Day
1st	+0	+0	+1	+1	Blood of music, conductor, natural armor increase +1	—
2nd	+1	+1	+1	+1	Ability boost (Dex +2), bloodline feat, well-versed	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
3rd	+2	+1	+2	+2	Perfect voice	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
4th	+3	+1	+2	+2	Ability boost (Dex +2), natural armor increase +2, versatile performance	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
5th	+3	+2	+3	+3	Bloodline feat, lore master 1/day	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
6th	+4	+2	+3	+3	Ability boost (Int +2)	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
7th	+5	+2	+4	+4	Natural armor increase +3, versatile performance	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
8th	+6	+3	+4	+4	Ability boost (Cha +2), bloodline feat	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
9th	+6	+3	+5	+5	Inspire	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
10th	+7	+3	+5	+5	Lore master 2/day, versatile performance	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
Natural Armor Increase (Ex)

At 1st, 4th, and 7th level, a maestro disciple’s skin toughens, causing a cumulative increase to her natural armor bonus of +1.

Ability Boost

As she gradually becomes more supple and intuitive through her bond with music, a maestro disciple gains stat boosts as noted on Table 14: Maestro Disciple.

These increases stack and are gained as if through level advancement.

Bloodline Feat

Upon reaching 2nd level, and every three levels thereafter, a maestro disciple receives one bonus feat, chosen from the sorcerer maestro bloodline’s bonus feat list or from the bloodrager maestro bloodline’s bonus feat list, depending on which one she is advancing with her level progression.

Well-Versed (Ex)

At 2nd level, a maestro disciple gains the well-versed bard ability. If she already possesses this ability, her saving throw bonus increases instead to +6.

Perfect Voice (Su)

At 3rd level, a maestro disciple gains the perfect voice ability of the sorcerer maestro bloodline, even if she doesn’t normally possess that power. Once her level is high enough to grant this ability through the bloodline, the bonus on save DCs of language-dependent spells she casts increases to +2.

Versatile Performance (Ex)

At 4th level, a maestro disciple gains the versatile performance bard ability. She can select another versatile performance, or an advanced versatile performance, at 7th and 10th level. If the maestro disciple selects a bardic masterpiece or skaldic saga, she can use it with her fascinate or battle song ability.

Lore Master (Ex)

At 5th level, a maestro disciple can use the lore master bard ability once per day. At 10th level, this increases to twice per day. If the maestro disciple already possesses the lore master ability from another class, her maestro disciple levels stack with levels in the class that grants it.

Inspire (Sp)

At 9th level, a maestro disciple gains the inspire bloodline power, even if she doesn’t normally possess that power. Once her level is high enough to grant this ability through the bloodline, the maestro disciple can use it 1 additional time per day.
